description: This file defines an interface 'DownloadCallback' that provides callback methods for handling download progress, network info, and completion events within an Android application.

classes.name: DownloadCallback
classes.description: Interface for handling download progress and status callbacks in an Android application.

methods.name: updateFromDownload
methods.description: Updates the UI or application state based on the download result.

methods.name: getActiveNetworkInfo
methods.description: Returns the current active network status as a NetworkInfo object.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Handles progress updates during download, specified by progress code and percentage.

methods.name: finishDownloading
methods.description: Notifies that the download operation has finished, regardless of success.
